references.text: Isaiah prophesies about the Messiah who is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins
Luke reports Jesus' words at the Last Supper, parallel to Matthew
Jeremiah prophesies about the new covenant, which involves forgiveness of sins
Hebrews explains the necessity of bloodshed for the forgiveness of sins
Hebrews compares Jesus' blood with Abel's, which speaks better than Abel's
